en: Khuddakapāṭha 3: The Thirty-Two Aspects In this body there are:
head-hairs, body-hairs, nails, teeth, skin; flesh, sinews, bones, bone-marrow, kidneys;
The heart, liver, midriff, spleen, lungs, intestines, mesentery,
gorge, feces, brain, bile, phlegm, pus, blood, sweat, fat, tears, grease, spittle, snot, synovial fluid, and urine—
